notes: Canada, USA and Mexico share similar longitudes (~95-106°W) but are stacked vertically across a large latitude range. Tests that the algorithm separates callouts vertically without connector crossings. FAIL: connector-cross (Canada/Mexico on desktop-fhd-typ, Canada/US on laptop-1440-typ) — both mercator.

callouts.headline: Canada federal election called
callouts.detail: The Canadian Prime Minister dissolves parliament and announces a general election date.

callouts.headline: US Fed cuts interest rates
callouts.detail: The Federal Reserve lowers its benchmark rate by 25 basis points, citing cooling inflation.

callouts.headline: Mexico City earthquake response
callouts.detail: Emergency teams deploy across the capital following a 6.2 magnitude earthquake in central Mexico.
